item.text: The current links point to query based catalog URLs, while the heading and products sit behind a Suspense boundary that fetches after navigation. I’m checking the framework’s prefetch behavior before choosing the smallest change that actually prepares each query result.

Both category links in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:15) now use `prefetch={true}`. Their `/catalog?category=...` URLs are unchanged. Next prepares each URL’s heading and products while the links are visible, so a click after prefetch completes can navigate without showing the loading state or waiting for a full server render.
